BiblicalUsage: leîmma means remnant, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Romans 11:5, "Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the remnant is God's answer to despair — even now, at this present time, there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
